name: mercury-router
description: Asks Mercury Decide (OpenRouter Decisions API) what kind of work each prompt is, then picks the Claude model and effort, keeping the prompt cache warm.

openrouterApiKey.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouterApiKey.description: Key used to call the router model on openrouter.ai.

routerModel.title: Router model
routerModel.description: OpenRouter Decisions model that makes the decision.

routeSubagents.title: Route subagents too
routeSubagents.description: Also apply the decision to subagent requests.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: How long the main conversation's prompt cache lives: 1h on a Claude subscription, 5m on an API key or a cloud provider. auto guesses from the environment.

showBand.title: Show the model above the prompt
showBand.description: Keeps a line above the prompt box naming the model, effort and cache hit rate of the running or last turn.

showFooter.title: Show the model under each answer
showFooter.description: Also adds that line under each answer (the desktop app folds it into a notice).
